_comment: kurau.wav Pelican egg candidate for ghcr.io/pipesick/kurau-wav:v2.11.1-kurau.3. Pin the published digest after the GHCR release is available. It does not modify the production BeatDock egg.
name: PipeSick - kurau.wav
author: pipesick-admin@example.invalid
description: kurau.wav, PipeSick branded BeatDock v2.11.1 distribution for Pelican with external Lavalink.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
cd /mnt/server
cat > README-PELICAN.txt <<'EOF'
kurau.wav runs from the GHCR image selected in this Pelican egg.
After publication, prefer pinning ghcr.io/pipesick/kurau-wav:v2.11.1-kurau.3 to its immutable digest.
Persistent configuration is stored in Pelican startup variables.
Do not paste real secrets into committed files.
EOF

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Discord bot token. Exposed to the container as TOKEN.

variables.name: Lavalink Host
variables.description: Reachable hostname or IP for the external Lavalink Pelican server.

variables.name: Lavalink Port
variables.description: Allocated Lavalink port.

variables.name: Lavalink Password
variables.description: Must match the external Lavalink server password.

variables.name: Default Language
variables.description: Primary language for kurau.wav.

variables.name: Brand Profile
variables.description: Branding profile to load.

variables.name: Theme Color
variables.description: kurau.wav embed color in #RRGGBB format.

variables.name: Personality Enabled
variables.description: Enable persona messages and locale overrides.

variables.name: Variants Enabled
variables.description: Enable random message variants with immediate-repeat protection.

variables.name: Public Event Messages
variables.description: Enable extra public session/event messages. Default false to prevent spam.

variables.name: Presence Rotation
variables.description: Enable slow idle presence rotation.

variables.name: Sarcasm Level
variables.description: Persona intensity setting. low selects stable neutral variants; medium and high allow rotating variants.

variables.name: Event Cooldown Seconds
variables.description: Cooldown for extra public event messages.

variables.name: Presence Interval Seconds
variables.description: Idle presence rotation interval.

variables.name: Spotify Enabled
variables.description: Enable Spotify resolving in Lavalink/LavaSrc. Must match Lavalink configuration.

variables.name: Spotify Client ID
variables.description: Spotify client ID. Leave blank when disabled.

variables.name: Spotify Client Secret
variables.description: Spotify client secret. Leave blank when disabled.

variables.name: Default Volume
variables.description: Default playback volume.

variables.name: Autoplay Default
variables.description: Enable autoplay by default when playback starts.

variables.name: Default Search Platform
variables.description: Default Lavalink search platform.
